new: 10 m and 6 m segments can be chosen on their own: the settings page ticks CW and Beacons for each, and --bands or BANDS takes 10:cw, 10:beacons, 6:cw, 6:beacons (all,10:cw skims 10 m's CW segment alone, a stream fewer at iq192); existing settings skim as before
fixed: 2200 and 630 m could not be chosen for an HPSDR, ka9q-radio or Skimmer Server radio in the settings, nor added to "Every band" on an UberSDR; both now offer them, for WSPR and FST4W
2200 m or 630 m given to two radios was not refused, and both decoded it; and a decoder could be set to the skimmed bands when none of them has its dials
a radio set to every band showed no bands in the settings, and choosing one there or adding a decoder's band replaced every band with that one; each radio now has its own Every band box
with two radios, one still needing bands marked both as needing them
--no-de and --no-heard were ignored for RTTY spots, which still went out on the RTTY and all-modes telnet ports and the page

new: an RTTY spot's details in the Spots tab say how its call was checked (MASTER.SCP, call shape) and how sure the reader was of it
fixed: an RTTY spot's details in the Spots tab showed no Decode

new: FT8 neural network, on by default (--ft8-nn off, FT8_NN "off" in Docker, or the Decode step of the settings page turns it off): it tries FT8 signals the usual decoding misses, for about 9% more FT8 decodes at about 1.7x the FT8 CPU; --ft8-nn-level 2 tries harder (about 10% for about 2.4x); a docker-compose.yml from before this release has FT8_NN "off", which keeps it off: set it to "on" or remove the line
fixed: RTTY spots showed no Evidence or Entity in the Spots tab

WSPR spots stopped reaching wsprnet.org while it was slow to answer: uploads timed out, the same spots went again and again, and a backlog grew without end; spots wsprnet takes but answers with an empty page are no longer given up on, and spots waiting over a day are now set aside

changed: RBN's node list shows the skimmer as UberSDR Skimmer and its release (for example UberSDR Skimmer v2026.11.08), not as Skimmer Server v.1.6.0.145

new: MSK144, the meteor-scatter mode, on 6 m (50.260 and 50.380 MHz): --msk144 (off unless asked for; the setup wizard's Decoders step, or MSK144 in Docker), to PSK Reporter, the Map and Analytics, with an MSK144 tab showing the last day's pings, when they came and the meteor showers active

fixed: the Analytics tab's WSPR noise and decoders charts, and everything on the RF tab, started empty again after every restart or update
on a Hermes Lite 2 (or another radio whose receivers fold in each other's signals) a weak copy of a signal 192 kHz away could still be spotted, such as a beacon on 28.2048 MHz also spotted on 28.0128
after a cold boot, the RBN reporter (and its local telnet port, such as 7550) did not start when the skimmer came up before UberSDR, until the skimmer was restarted
a weak beacon not in RBN's list was also spotted under a misread call one character off (M7KWQ/B beside W7KWQ/B on the same frequency)
a sign-off run together, like "TU ES 73 DE N9PWY", was spotted as a bogus call (ES73DE)
a CW runner signing off with "TU <call> CQ" or "TU <call> QRZ?" was spotted only as heard, not as CQ
callers answering a CW runner were sometimes spotted as calling CQ on the runner's frequency
